candidate.user_submission: Pikin na 18 months. E get fever for 2 days. E body hot reach 38.0°C. Di pikin dey for area wey malaria risk high, and malaria test dey available. E get fever but no cough or difficult breathing, e no get diarrhoea, and e never get ear problem before. E never dey convulse now and e never get convulsion before. Di pikin no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. E dey fit drink or breastfeed. E no dey vomit everything. No sign say rash dey body, no sign say bacteria cause dey, and dem never see any obvious cause for di fever. E no get cough for measles, e never get measles for di last 3 months. E eye no red, e no get catarrh, and neck no stiff.
